mechanism: Rate Limiting: Maximum N {{task}}s per time window W. Excess requests rejected, queued, or delayed. Window can be sliding or fixed. Separate limits per action type or global. Utilizes {{backoff}}.
failure_modes: Unbounded queue: `excess_policy` is queue or delay and arrivals stay above the limit, so latency grows without anything being dropped or refused.
invariants: Rate limit: output rate ≤ `rate_limit` within any `window`, sliding or fixed.
Excess is handled by the declared `excess_policy` — rejected, queued, or delayed. Only rejection drops.
preconditions: Token bucket or Leaky bucket state initialized

parameters.name: excess_policy
parameters.description: What happens above the limit. Named in the intersection and previously expressible nowhere.
